instructions: Drafts only, not published GitHub issues. After authenticating the project integration, list all existing issues and reconcile these scopes before creating duplicates. IDs below are local planning IDs, not GitHub issue numbers.

issues.title: Phase 0: Finalize the pilot scope and evaluation dataset
issues.body:
## Goal
Define a measurable pilot before implementing channel-specific or market-specific behavior.

## Implementation
- Complete docs/prd-mvp.md with the business owner: one product, market, exporter/importer role, initial language pair, and one initial channel.
- Resolve the roadmap's one-channel versus WhatsApp-plus-email ambiguity.
- Record product units, currency, price floor, discount rules, payment terms, capacity and sensitive counterparties.
- Collect 10–20 anonymized real conversations with consent; keep synthetic examples explicitly labeled.
- Label expected intent, summary, next question and policy decision for evaluation.

## Acceptance and tests
- No business-critical TODO remains in the pilot PRD.
- Dataset contains no personal identifiers or commercial secrets unsuitable for test fixtures.
- Record baseline human response-writing time and the protocol for measuring the 50% reduction target.

## Dependencies
Business-owner decisions and authorized sample conversations. Never invent these inputs.

issues.title: Foundation: Authenticate users and enforce role-based access
issues.body:
## Goal
Make the existing prototype safe for a real team; current routes have no authentication.

## Implementation
- Agree the deployment's supported identity provider and validate authenticated sessions server-side.
- Introduce manager and sales roles, deny by default, and scope contacts, threads and policies to the authorized organization.
- Restrict policy management and sensitive pricing data to managers.
- Derive audit actor identity from authentication, never from request fields or a hardcoded human label.
- Require an authenticated human action for commercial confirmation; an agent cannot assert human identity.

## Acceptance and tests
- Anonymous, expired-session, wrong-role and cross-organization requests are denied.
- Test every write route, audit access and confirmation permissions.
- No credentials or raw authentication artifacts enter logs or API responses.

## Dependencies
Identity-provider choice and database migrations. Blocks public deployment and trusted approvals.

issues.title: Foundation: Add versioned database migrations and persistence tests
issues.body:
## Goal
Replace startup create_all with a reproducible migration lifecycle before changing production schemas.

## Implementation
- Add Alembic and a baseline matching all existing models.
- Document and test adoption of an existing SQLite prototype without data loss.
- Introduce indexed thread/contact lookups and due-follow-up queries.
- Enforce policy version uniqueness and transactional activation under concurrent writes.
- Validate foreign keys, UTC timestamp behavior and JSON fields on the supported production PostgreSQL version.

## Acceptance and tests
- Fresh database upgrades to head; existing fixture data survives migration.
- Invalid relationships fail and concurrent policy creation cannot produce conflicting active versions.
- Migration failures roll back without silently recreating tables.

## Dependencies
Registered PostgreSQL test/deployment environment; heavy infrastructure builds run only on the registered server.

issues.title: Phase 1: Implement the read-only multilingual conversation copilot
issues.body:
## Goal
Turn a received message into a useful, reviewable draft without automatic sending.

## Implementation
- Start with the existing manual message ingestion API; add the selected official channel adapter behind the same internal message contract.
- Add a provider-independent generation boundary with structured output validation, timeouts, bounded retries and explicit failure responses.
- Produce a thread summary, intent, evidence-based lead assessment, target-language draft and suggested next questions.
- Treat conversation content as untrusted data; do not permit it to alter company policy or invoke tools.
- Persist draft, source-message IDs, model/prompt version and policy version for reproducibility.
- Never fabricate prices, availability, payment promises or delivery commitments when inputs are absent.

## Acceptance and tests
- Evaluation fixtures cover the selected language pair, missing context, hostile message instructions, invalid model output and provider failure.
- All generated content remains a draft; no sending API is invoked.
- Pilot measures the roadmap's 50% response-writing-time reduction; do not claim success from unit tests alone.

## Dependencies
Pilot scope, authorized model integration, authentication for deployment, and policy-review workflow.

issues.title: Phase 2: Complete durable follow-up detection and notifications
issues.body:
## Existing implementation
Commit 7e58f6b adds filtered/paginated thread lists, timezone-aware manual scheduling, completion/cancellation, due-thread queries, reply-triggered cancellation, transition/follow-up audit and 14 SQLite integration tests. This is not an automatic scheduler or notification system.

## Remaining implementation
- Define configurable inactivity and explicitly promised follow-up rules; do not infer contractual deadlines.
- Add a bounded worker that records reminders for eligible open threads and a durable in-app notification inbox.
- Use an idempotency key per thread/reminder revision; retries must not duplicate notifications.
- Recheck reminder eligibility before delivery and cancel stale work after reply, rescheduling or confirmation.
- Authenticate and authorize schedule/complete/cancel operations; add atomic updates for competing workers or users.

## Acceptance and tests
- Existing 14 tests remain green.
- Cover restart recovery, simultaneous completion, duplicate worker runs, exact due-time boundaries and reply-versus-delivery races.
- No automatic outbound commercial message is sent.

## Dependencies
Authentication, migrations and a registered worker deployment target.

issues.title: Phase 3: Implement policy-aware draft review and protected transitions
issues.body:
## Goal
Connect the existing policy evaluator and state machine to an enforceable human-review workflow.

## Implementation
- Validate finite nonnegative prices, currency/unit compatibility and discount range at API boundaries.
- Associate structured offers and drafts with product and immutable policy version.
- Evaluate price floor, discounts, allowed payment terms, capacity and sensitive country/customer rules, including Contact.is_sensitive.
- Persist all violations together; unknown/missing policy must fail closed.
- Add authenticated approve/edit/reject operations with reasons and optimistic concurrency.
- Re-evaluate changed commercial terms and invalidate stale approvals after relevant policy changes.
- Gate transitions on the reviewed offer and require explicit human confirmation; never infer approval from a generated draft.

## Acceptance and tests
- Table-driven tests cover each violation, combined violations, sensitive contacts, policy changes and illegal state transitions.
- Unauthorized approval and confirmation are denied; competing edits cannot reuse stale approval.
- Audit records identify actual actor, policy version, prior/new state and reasons transactionally.

## Dependencies
Authentication, migrations and finalized commercial policy.

issues.title: MVP: Build the human-review and opportunities dashboard
issues.body:
## Goal
Give the pilot team a usable view of conversations, pending drafts and follow-ups.

## Implementation
- Implement authenticated opportunities list with stage, contact, last activity and next follow-up filters.
- Add thread history, summary, draft editing, policy warnings and explicit approve/reject actions.
- Provide schedule/reschedule/cancel/complete controls and a due-notification inbox.
- Restrict policy settings to managers and show both policy version and review status.
- Support Persian RTL navigation while rendering foreign-language message content with its own direction.
- Include accessible form labels, loading/empty/error states and stale-update conflict handling.

## Acceptance and tests
- Type-check, lint and component/integration tests cover filters, validation, authorization failures and API errors.
- Verify untrusted message content is rendered as text, not executable markup.
- Obtain user-supplied screenshots or external manual review for visual verification; browser automation is unavailable in this environment.

## Dependencies
Authentication and stable copilot/review API contracts.

issues.title: Phase 4: Extract and compare supplier offers with source evidence
issues.body:
## Implementation
- Accept authorized offer text and supported files with size/type limits.
- Extract product, currency, unit price, MOQ, delivery estimate, payment terms and Incoterm with source references.
- Preserve unknown values; never invent missing terms.
- Compare like-for-like offers; flag incompatible currencies/units rather than silently converting them.
- Show transparency/payment/shipping risk flags and draft counteroffer messages through the policy-review workflow.

## Acceptance and tests
- Fixtures cover missing fields, contradictory terms, multiple currencies, malformed uploads and extraction failures.
- Every compared value traces to a source and no ranking implies a guaranteed safe supplier.
- No counteroffer is sent automatically.

## Dependencies
Importer pilot decision, copilot extraction boundary, authentication and policy review.

issues.title: Phase 5: Generate reviewed proforma drafts and integrate approved orders
issues.body:
## Implementation
- Model line items, quantities, units, currency, payment terms, Incoterm and human-confirmed delivery assumptions.
- Create versioned proforma drafts from reviewed conversation data; visibly mark unapproved documents as drafts.
- Read catalog/pricing/stock only from an explicitly authorized CRM/ERP adapter.
- Export only human-approved orders using idempotency keys and an auditable delivery status.
- Require a fresh review after any material edit; retries cannot duplicate external orders.

## Acceptance and tests
- Test precise monetary totals, missing mandatory fields, approval invalidation, adapter timeouts and duplicate export retries.
- No unapproved order or proforma is represented as a binding commitment.

## Dependencies
Policy review, migrations and an explicitly registered CRM/ERP integration.

issues.title: Phase 6: Expand official channel adapters and market language support
issues.body:
## Implementation
- Add only channels prioritized by validated pilot demand and supported by official APIs.
- Normalize external thread/message IDs and use idempotent ingestion for duplicate/out-of-order events.
- Apply official webhook verification through the authorized integration without exposing credentials.
- Add per-market language/tone configuration and evaluation fixtures for each supported language.
- Preserve original messages alongside translations and track translation/model provenance.

## Acceptance and tests
- Contract tests cover duplicate events, unsupported payloads, rate limits, revoked integration access and language fallback.
- No scraping, unofficial account access or automatic unapproved sending.

## Dependencies
Successful pilot, authorized integrations and stable internal message/review contracts.

issues.title: Phase 7: Measure conversion, response time and follow-up outcomes
issues.body:
## Implementation
- Define events and metric semantics for open opportunities, human-confirmed orders, first response time and follow-up outcomes.
- Derive reporting from auditable events without storing unnecessary message content.
- Distinguish missing/incomplete data from zero outcomes and use organization-scoped access.
- Add consented tone experiments only after baseline metrics are reliable; persist assignment and human edits.
- Use human rejection/edit feedback to propose improvements, never to silently loosen commercial policy.

## Acceptance and tests
- Deterministic fixture reports verify denominators, timezone boundaries, repeated events and corrected outcomes.
- Small samples are labeled inconclusive and cross-organization reporting is denied.

## Dependencies
Authenticated usage, reliable audit events, pilot volume and explicit experiment approval.
